diagnosis: Checks C2 and C4 are leaking because they pass even when the model makes generic or default decisions that do not satisfy the specific requirements of PF2 and PF3. In all rollouts, the model selects 'Glass City' for both documentary and trailer music (failing to trigger the replacement required by PF3/C4) and provides vague credits like 'archive' or 'not specified' (failing to meet the exact string requirement of PF2/C2), yet the checks incorrectly register as true.

C2.why: The signed museum permission establishes that the subway excerpt can remain only with the exact credit "Courtesy of Metro Archive," changing both the retained excerpt and its delivery credit.

C4.why: The composer confirmation permits "Glass City" in the documentary only with the exact Elena Vale credit and forces the trailer to use "Open Circuit" with a replacement commitment.
